mapper.update: MERGE INTO lot target USING ( SELECT resolved.lot_id, CASE WHEN resolved.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND resolved.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND LEAST(TRUNC(resolved.expiry_date), TRUNC(resolved.sale_stop_date)) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN CASE WHEN TRUNC(resolved.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(resolved.sale_stop_date) THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'SALE_STOPPED' END WHEN resolved.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(resolved.expiry_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN resolved.sale_stop_date IS NOT NULL AND TRUNC(resolved.sale_stop_date) <= TRUNC(CAST(#{asOfDate} AS DATE)) THEN 'SALE_STOPPED' WHEN NVL(balance.total_quantity, 0) = 0 THEN 'DEPLETED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS lot_status FROM lot resolved LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ib.lot_id, SUM(ib.on_hand_qty + ib.reserved_qty) AS total_quantity FROM inventory_balance ib WHERE ib.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY ib.lot_id ) balance ON balance.lot_id = resolved.lot_id WHERE resolved.is_deleted = 0 ) source ON (target.lot_id = source.lot_id AND target.is_deleted = 0) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.lot_status = source.lot_status, target.updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, target.updated_by = #{actorId} WHERE NVL(target.lot_status, '__NULL__') != source.lot_status
